description: Read an app's accessibility tree (default: the frontmost app's focused window). app: a name, a bundle id, a .app path or pid:<n> — ambiguous_app when several running apps match; pick one by pid:<n> from its list. Returns {app, snapshot_id, window, complete, elements:[{i, d, role, title, value, states, actions, frame}]}; i is the element_index for mac_click, mac_get, mac_set_value, mac_type, mac_scroll and mac_drag — unique across snapshots, valid 30 s; an action re-identifies the element first (element_no_longer_valid if gone, moved or replaced). Options: interactive (actionable elements only), compact (default true: skip empty layout wrappers), skeleton (a shallow map with children_count), then root (an element_index to drill into, given alone: not with app, window, window_id or surface; adds indexes to the same snapshot), surface (window|menubar|menu|sheet|alert|dialog|popover|focused|app), window (index or title) or window_id (from mac_windows), depth (default 12, 1-40), max_nodes (default 400), web_accessibility (default true; false under NORACU_READ_ONLY=1): sets AXManualAccessibility on Electron/Chromium apps, never AXEnhancedUserInterface; the result says enabled, already_on, exposed (refused, but the pages are in the tree) or unsupported with a web_accessibility_hint (Google Chrome refuses it) — unknown, with the hint, when the window was too large to look through. window_identity unverifiable marks a window without a window ID: element_index actions in it are refused. ax_empty when the app has no readable window.
name: mac_ax_state
